{{RV|type=function

|game1= tkoh
|version1= 1.00

|game2= arma3
|version2= 0.50

|gr1= Conversations

|descr= Skip a conversation started with [[BIS_fnc_kbTell]]. Currently played sentence will be finished.

|s1= [topicName, mission, wait] call [[BIS_fnc_kbSkip]]

|p1= topicName: [[String]] or [[Object]] - either topic name or the person currently talking

|p2= mission: [[String]] - (Optional, default [[missionName]])

|p3= wait: [[Boolean]] or [[Array]] or [[Number]]

|r1= [[Boolean]] or [[Number]]

|x1= <sqf>["topic1", "currentMission"] call BIS_fnc_kbSkip;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>[player] call BIS_fnc_kbSkip;</sqf>
